title: The Feels
theme: Contemporary R&B's era of emotional exposure — 2008 to 2013, when artists like Frank Ocean, Jhené Aiko, Miguel, and Jazmine Sullivan made vulnerability the aesthetic and the charts agreed.
narrativePurpose: Test knowledge of the breakthrough records, labels, albums, and biographical facts behind the generation of R&B artists who defined the early 2010s — a period when the genre's emotional range expanded dramatically.
toneProgression: Identify the track, the artist, and the album → labels, chart history, Grammy credits, and production context → birth names, birthplaces, and the personal facts behind the era's most intimate records

vault.note: Digit 4 (index 3) is always visible. Vault code 2-0-1-2 — the year that crystallised this era: Frank Ocean's Channel ORANGE, Miguel's Kaleidoscope Dream, and Elle Varner's Conversational Lush all arrived in 2012, making it the most critically significant year in early 2010s R&B. The year the genre's new emotional architecture became undeniable.

rounds.name: RADIO HITS
rounds.description: The records, the artists, and the albums. Entry level — but this era rewards those who were paying attention.

questions.question: At the 55th Grammy Awards in 2013, which artist won Best R&B Song for 'Adorn'?

metadata.fact: 'Adorn' won Best R&B Song at the 55th Annual Grammy Awards in 2013 — Miguel's first Grammy win and confirmation that his album Kaleidoscope Dream had positioned him as one of the defining voices of the new R&B generation.
metadata.storyHook: The 55th Grammys. Best R&B Song. 'Adorn.' Miguel took the trophy and made the year's clearest statement about where R&B was going.

questions.question: Frank Ocean's 'Thinkin Bout You' appeared on which critically acclaimed 2012 debut studio album?

metadata.fact: Channel ORANGE (2012) was Frank Ocean's debut studio album — released through Def Jam — and debuted at #2 on the Billboard 200. 'Thinkin Bout You' was its lead single and became one of the most emotionally resonant R&B records of the era, establishing Ocean as a generational voice.
metadata.storyHook: Channel ORANGE. 2012. 'Thinkin Bout You' was the introduction. What followed was one of the decade's most important albums.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Frank Ocean 'Thinkin Bout You' from Channel ORANGE (2012), Def Jam Records, debut at #2 Billboard 200. Must be sourced before production.

questions.question: Kelly Rowland's 2011 single 'Motivation' featured which rapper on the hook?

metadata.fact: 'Motivation' — from Kelly Rowland's 2011 album Here I Am — featured Lil Wayne and became one of the most-played R&B singles of that summer, reaching #1 on the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart.
metadata.storyHook: Kelly Rowland. Lil Wayne. Summer 2011. 'Motivation' was everywhere — and for good reason.

questions.question: 'It Kills Me' was the breakthrough hit for which Canadian R&B singer?

metadata.fact: 'It Kills Me' appeared on Melanie Fiona's debut album The Bridge (2009) and became her commercial breakthrough — reaching #1 on the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart. Fiona is Canadian, born in Toronto to parents of Guyanese heritage, and represented a strong wave of Caribbean-Canadian R&B talent.
metadata.storyHook: Canadian. Guyanese heritage. A debut album. A number-one R&B single. Melanie Fiona arrived with 'It Kills Me' and made the case immediately.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Melanie Fiona 'It Kills Me' from The Bridge (2009), #1 R&B, Canadian artist. Must be sourced before production.

questions.question: Trey Songz's 'Neighbors Know My Name' appeared on which 2009 album — his commercial breakthrough?

metadata.fact: Ready (2009) was Trey Songz's third studio album and commercial breakthrough — debuting at #3 on the Billboard 200 and containing 'Neighbors Know My Name,' which became one of his signature records. The album established his persona as contemporary R&B's most unapologetically sensual voice.
metadata.storyHook: Ready. 2009. The album that turned Trey Songz from a promising act into the sound of a generation's Saturday nights.

questions.question: Jazmine Sullivan's 'Holding You Down (Goin' in Circles)' appeared on which 2010 album?

metadata.fact: Love Me Back (2010) was Jazmine Sullivan's second studio album — released on J Records — and contained 'Holding You Down (Goin' in Circles),' a portrait of the emotional trap of a one-sided relationship that became one of the era's most unflinching love songs.
metadata.storyHook: Love Me Back. Jazmine Sullivan told the truth about loving someone who doesn't love you back — and 'Holding You Down' was the most honest version of that truth.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Jazmine Sullivan 'Holding You Down' from Love Me Back (2010), J Records. Must be sourced before production.

questions.question: Lloyd's 'Lay It Down' appeared on which 2008 album?

metadata.fact: 'Lay It Down' appeared on Lessons in Love (2008) — Lloyd's third studio album — and reached #1 on the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart.
metadata.storyHook: Geffen Records. 2008. 'Lay It Down' was Lloyd's moment — and the number-one R&B record confirmed it.

reserve.question: Jhené Aiko's 'The Worst' appeared on which 2013 debut EP?

metadata.fact: Sail Out (2013) was Jhené Aiko's debut EP — released through Def Jam — and contained 'The Worst,' a bare, confessional account of being mistreated in a relationship. The EP's minimal production and Aiko's whispered delivery established an aesthetic that alternative R&B had not previously defined this precisely.
metadata.storyHook: Sail Out. A debut EP. 'The Worst.' Jhené Aiko arrived in 2013 already knowing exactly who she was as an artist.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Jhené Aiko 'The Worst' from Sail Out EP (2013), Def Jam Records. Must be sourced before production.

reserve.question: 'Finding My Way Back' was a single from which 2010 Jaheim album?

metadata.fact: 'Finding My Way Back' was the second single from Jaheim's 2010 album Another Round — a smooth, reflective R&B record that reinforced his reputation as one of the genre's most consistent balladeers in the late 2000s and early 2010s.
metadata.storyHook: Jaheim. Another Round. 2010. 'Finding My Way Back' was everything his audience expected — and delivered without compromise.

reserve.question: 'Refill' was the breakthrough single for which R&B artist — who also released the 2012 mixtape Conversational Lush?

metadata.fact: 'Refill' was Elle Varner's debut single — released in 2011 ahead of her 2012 album Conversational Lush on RCA Records. The song's earthy, jazz-inflected production and Varner's distinctive rasp immediately set her apart from her contemporaries, earning critical praise and establishing her as one of the most promising new voices in the genre.
metadata.storyHook: A debut single. A distinctive voice. 'Refill' introduced Elle Varner and gave the new R&B generation one of its most promising arrivals.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Elle Varner 'Refill' debut single (2011), Conversational Lush album (2012), RCA Records. Must be sourced before production.

reserve.question: Melanie Fiona won Best Traditional R&B Performance at the Grammys for 'Fool for You' — a collaboration with which artist?

metadata.fact: Melanie Fiona won the Grammy for Best Traditional R&B Performance for 'Fool for You' — recorded with CeeLo Green. The award recognised her vocal command on a track that sat squarely in the classic soul tradition, a different register entirely from the contemporary R&B of 'It Kills Me.'
metadata.storyHook: She broke through with 'It Kills Me.' She won the Grammy with CeeLo Green. Melanie Fiona had more than one mode — and the Academy noticed.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Melanie Fiona won Best Traditional R&B Performance for 'Fool for You' with CeeLo Green. Must be sourced before production.

rounds.name: DEEP CUTS

questions.question: Miguel was born under which full birth name?

metadata.fact: Miguel was born Miguel Jontel Pimentel on October 23, 1985, in San Pedro, Los Angeles, California. He performs under his first name only — a decision that emphasised the intimacy and directness his music was built around.
metadata.storyHook: Miguel Jontel Pimentel. Born in San Pedro, California. He went by one name. The music made sure you remembered it.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Miguel born Miguel Jontel Pimentel, San Pedro, California. Must be sourced before production.

questions.question: Frank Ocean — whose 'Thinkin Bout You' defined 2012 R&B — was born under which name?

metadata.fact: Frank Ocean was born Christopher Edwin Breaux on October 28, 1987, in New Orleans, Louisiana. He adopted the stage name Frank Ocean — partly as an homage to Frank Sinatra and partly as a clean break from the name he grew up with — as he transitioned from ghostwriting to recording his own material.
metadata.storyHook: Christopher Breaux became Frank Ocean. The name change was part of the reinvention — and Channel ORANGE made the new identity permanent.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Frank Ocean born Christopher Breaux (full: Christopher Edwin Breaux), New Orleans. Must be sourced before production.

sources.title: Frank Ocean, born Christopher Edwin Breaux – Instagram bio reel

questions.question: Trey Songz — the man behind 'Neighbors Know My Name' — performs under a stage name. What is his birth name?

metadata.fact: Trey Songz was born Tremaine Aldon Neverson on November 28, 1984, in Petersburg, Virginia. The stage name — a reference to him being the third (Trey) singer/songwriter in his family lineage — replaced a birth name that carried the full weight of his Southern roots.
metadata.storyHook: Tremaine Aldon Neverson. Petersburg, Virginia. He became Trey Songz. The neighbours knew his name — and eventually so did everyone else.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Trey Songz born Tremaine Aldon Neverson, Petersburg, Virginia. Must be sourced before production.

questions.question: 'Adorn' appeared on which 2012 Miguel album — his second studio release?

metadata.fact: Kaleidoscope Dream (2012) was Miguel's second studio album — released on RCA Records — and the record that established him as one of the most distinctive voices in contemporary R&B. 'Adorn' was its lead single and Grammy-winning centrepiece.
metadata.storyHook: Kaleidoscope Dream. Second album. Lead single wins a Grammy. Miguel made the case for himself with one record — and the industry agreed.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Miguel Kaleidoscope Dream (2012), RCA Records, 'Adorn' as lead single. Must be sourced before production.

reserve.question: Jazmine Sullivan's 2008 debut album — which preceded Love Me Back — was titled what?

metadata.fact: Fearless (2008) was Jazmine Sullivan's debut studio album — released on J Records — and introduced her voice to a mainstream audience that had been prepared for her by years of industry word-of-mouth. The album produced 'Bust Your Windows' and established Sullivan as Philadelphia's most formidable new R&B voice.
metadata.storyHook: Fearless. The debut. Before Love Me Back. Jazmine Sullivan arrived in 2008 with an album that lived up to its title.

reserve.question: Trey Songz — who recorded 'Neighbors Know My Name' — was born in which small Virginia city?

metadata.fact: Trey Songz was born in Petersburg, Virginia — a small city south of Richmond — before eventually relocating to pursue his music career. His Southern roots informed the unhurried, intimate quality of his vocal delivery, a style that 'Neighbors Know My Name' exemplified perfectly.
metadata.storyHook: Petersburg, Virginia. Not a city that defines R&B. But it's where Trey Songz came from — and where the voice was built.

questions.question: Jaheim — who recorded 'Finding My Way Back' — was born with which surname?

metadata.fact: Jaheim was born Jaheim Hoagland in Jersey City, New Jersey. He performs under his first name only — a choice that emphasised both the intimacy of his vocal style and the directness of his lyrical approach to love and relationships.
metadata.storyHook: Jaheim Hoagland. Jersey City. He performed under one name. The surname disappeared — but the voice made sure nobody forgot who was singing.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Jaheim born Jaheim Hoagland, Jersey City, New Jersey. Must be sourced before production.

questions.question: Jhené Aiko — whose 'The Worst' is one of the era's most confessional love songs — was born under which full name?

metadata.fact: Jhené Aiko was born Jhené Aiko Efuru Chilombo on March 16, 1988, in Los Angeles, California. She performs under a shortened version of her name — Jhené Aiko — with her surname Chilombo carried more prominently in later years, including as the title of her 2020 album.
metadata.storyHook: Jhené Aiko Efuru Chilombo. Born in Los Angeles. 'The Worst' made the full name irrelevant — one name was enough to know exactly who was singing.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Jhené Aiko born Jhené Aiko Efuru Chilombo, Los Angeles. Must be sourced before production.

metadata.storyHook: Lloyd Polite Jr. Born in Atlanta. Performed as Lloyd. 'Lay It Down' made one name more than enough.

reserve.question: Frank Ocean — born Christopher Breaux — grew up in which US city before relocating to Los Angeles?

metadata.fact: Frank Ocean was born and grew up in New Orleans, Louisiana, before relocating to Los Angeles following Hurricane Katrina in 2005. The displacement — and the losses it entailed — shaped the emotional texture of his writing in ways he has spoken about in various interviews.
metadata.storyHook: New Orleans. Hurricane Katrina. Los Angeles. Frank Ocean's biography runs deeper than Channel ORANGE suggests — and New Orleans is where it started.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Frank Ocean born and raised in New Orleans, relocated to LA after Hurricane Katrina. Must be sourced before production.

reserve.question: 'Adorn' artist Miguel was born and raised in which Southern California city?

metadata.fact: Miguel was born and raised in San Pedro — a neighbourhood in the southern part of Los Angeles — before pursuing his music career. San Pedro's working-class character and cultural diversity shaped the eclectic influences that run through Kaleidoscope Dream.
metadata.storyHook: San Pedro, Los Angeles. Not the part of the city that shows up in R&B mythology. But that's where Miguel came from — and Kaleidoscope Dream carried it.
metadata.sourceNotes: PRIORITY VERIFY: Miguel born and raised in San Pedro, Los Angeles. Must be sourced before production.
